outcome: Notice when a plant needs attention.

views.title: Plant care
views.condition: With plants 0.3.0, set plants: discover in Ramka (or list the plants). Up to six plants share a page by default; more turn in pages, the ones that need something first.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

setup: Place the Mi Flora probe in the soil following the device instructions.
Provide Bluetooth coverage and verify fresh readings in Home Assistant.
Map each plant and its thresholds, optionally with a photo; Ramka 0.7.0 finds the plants itself with plants: discover.
